title: executive daily priorities - Zoe Martinez 2026-03-09
content:
Daily priorities — Mon 2026-03-09

Quick note: focused day — finalize canary plan, prep 1:1s, follow up with sales on Dedicated pilot. Keep this as my working scratchpad; items will shift.

Top priorities
- Canary rollout for v2-kv-cache (prod) — final decision today. Need: latency baseline comparison (p50/p95), rollback plan, Ops playbook. Check PR #2123 status (merge blockers: linux kernel kv fallback). Owner: eng-serving-runtime (Avery). Ask: SRE on-call to confirm canary window 10:00-14:00 PT.
- Dedicated pilot commercial terms — align with legal on data residency language. Draft to Sales by EOD. Action: send updated SOW to Priya and Legal (link Confluence page). Owner: Ravi.
- Exec sync slide deck — 5 slides: rollout status, risks, runway impact. 15 min slot Wed-10:30. Need one chart: cost delta pre/post-quantization. Pull numbers from finance deck (ask FP&A).

Meetings / timeblocks
- 09:00 — 09:30: Leadership standup (agenda: canary decision, capacity alerts)
- 10:00 — 11:00: Canary kickoff with serving-runtime + SRE (goal: freeze rollout plan)
- 12:00 — 12:30: 1:1 with Avery — focus hiring priorities and blockers
- 15:00 — 15:30: Customer call (Acme Corp) — Dedicated pilot scoping (prepare flow diagram + security Qs)
- 16:00 — 16:45: Sales handoff / T&Cs review

Follow-ups & notes
- INF-4821 (KV cache eviction bug) — needs repro steps and test case. Put on Avery's plate; if not fixed by 5pm, revert canary.
- Confirm KMS integration checklist for Private deployments before signing pilot contract; Legal to validate key rotation language.
- Ask Product to add a metric in console: per-route quantization% (for Redwood Optimize). Jira ticket? Create if not present.

Quick TODOs (today)
- [ ] finalize canary rollout doc + Ops playbook
- [ ] email Sales & Legal SOW draft
- [ ] update exec slides with cost charts
- [ ] slack message to SRE on canary window
- [ ] triage INF-4821 with reproducer

Notes to self
- Keep communications high-level for exec deck — avoid technical deep-dive. Add appendix for infra team.
- Risk list: rollback speed, cross-region consistency, customer data residency. Predefine rollback thresholds.
- Prepare fallback model variants list (smaller quantized + non-quantized) for automatic routing.

Reference links / tickets
- Confluence: Model rollout plan — https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Model+rollout+plan
- Jira: INF-4821, SALES-709
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2123
- Slack thread: #canary-launch (pin notes)

Questions / unresolved
- Does Dedicated pilot require SOC2 addendum? (Legal to confirm)
- Can we shorten canary window if p95 exceeds threshold faster? Ops policy note.

End of scratchpad — will tidy later and push finalized docs to shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime.
